notes.description: NaiveDft backend is O(n²). For n>1024, performance degrades significantly. Production use requires FFT algorithm (Cooley-Tukey).
notes.mitigation: Backend abstraction allows drop-in replacement. NaiveDft serves as oracle for correctness validation.

notes.description: Shared global plan cache uses Mutex<HashMap>. Concurrent access from parallel tests can cause cache collisions if test sizes overlap.
notes.mitigation: Tests use unique sizes outside proptest ranges. Plan cache is cleared between test groups.

notes.description: NaN/Inf inputs in Strict mode propagate silently. Hardened mode rejects non-finite inputs.
notes.mitigation: check_finite option and adversarial test cases cover NaN/Inf propagation behavior.

notes.description: When output_len is None, irfft infers 2*(n-1). Mismatched lengths produce incorrect reconstructions.
notes.mitigation: E2E tests cover explicit and inferred output lengths. Error cases return FftError.
